matrix = [[1, 2, 3], [4, 5, 6]]
deps = {"cook": {"shop"}, "eat": {"cook"}, "clean": {"eat"}, "shop": set()}
levels = [sorted(group) for group in solve_dependencies({key: set(value) for key, value in deps.items()})]
items = [("second", -1), ("meter", 1), ("kilogram", 1)]
state = {
    "matrix": matrix_apply(matrix, decrement)[0],
    "levels": [group[0] for group in levels],
    "format": formatter(items, single_denominator=True),
}

print(state)
print(state["levels"][1:])
print(state["format"].replace(" / ", " per "))
